content: Tuki
»Tuki mɨpatsie keneutawewi tamamata rinu 'ixurikiyarikɨ 'ayeyeumekɨ, meta muxa hiruyari 'uariekame mɨyɨtsikimaɨye meta kwimɨxetakɨ metatsiere mɨxetakɨ, Kakaɨyari teɨtamete mehaxutɨkaime.
Naitɨ rinu 'ixurikiyari yaxeikɨa pɨyeyeuka, tamamata heimana huta meturuyari heimana 'imeriyu pɨtɨni meta xeimeturuyari heimana nauka tewiyari tsenitimeturuyari patayeyeuka.
»Keneutawipa 'ixuriki 'auxɨwime, yuwiwiyame keneuyuri, hipameta 'auxɨwime yaxeikɨa keneuyuri.
Matɨari pemitawipaxɨtsie 'imatɨrieka 'ixurikitsie, hakɨrɨi kenawɨtɨaxɨa muxa witayarikɨ mɨyɨtsikimaɨyekɨ, meta yaxeikɨa ketineuyuri hutarieka miemetsie.
Matɨari pemitawipaxɨtsie kenawɨtɨa huta tewiyari heimana tamamata hakɨrɨi, yaxeikɨata paɨmeme hutarieka miemetsie, naitɨ yaxeikɨa papaɨmeme mexeiyatɨkanikɨ.
Hikɨta huru kwatsituraiyari 'etsipepeme keneutiwewi, huta tewiyari heimana tamamata 'ixuriki 'amɨyeyeu muyuwiyakɨ, tuki hetsie yuxewiriyatɨ mayanikɨ.
»Tamamata heimana xewi tsipuri wahuxari 'ɨkariyari 'ayeyeume keneutiwewi, tuki manukanarekɨ 'ixuriki kiyari hepaɨ tiyuxexeiyatɨ.
Yaxeikɨa pɨyeyeuka naitɨ, tamamata heimana haika meturuyari heimana 'imeriyu tɨtɨkame meta xeimeturuyari heimana nauka tewiyari tsenitimeturuyari 'atayeyeume.
Keneutawipa 'auxɨwime 'ɨkariyari yuxewitɨ mayanikɨ, hipameta 'ataxewime yuxewiriyame, 'ataxewirieka mieme tuki hɨxie muwiere patitunire.
»Huta tewiyari heimana tamamata kenawɨtɨaxɨa hakɨrɨi matɨari pemitawipaxɨtsie 'imatɨrieka 'ɨkariyaritsie, tawarita hutarieka miemetsie yaxeikɨa paɨmeme.
Hikɨta wurunitse kwatsitɨraiyari keneutiwewi 'etsipepeme huta tewiyari heimana tamamata, hakɨrɨi mawɨtɨkatsie keneuyehatɨaxɨa tuki mayanikɨ, yuxewiriyatɨ naitɨ kanayeimɨkɨ.
Mɨkɨ 'ɨkari tamamata mɨhɨkɨ, xewitɨ mɨkɨ naitsata panukawereni 'anuyuhayewatɨ mɨkɨ tuki warita peukawiwieka.
Mɨkɨ 'ixurikitsie panayuhayeikawani huta tewiyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari tapa kɨtsimeyaritsie meta tapatatsiere, mɨkɨkɨ tukita pɨreunare.
»Heimana manukawerire keneutawewi tuki hetsiemieme, muxatsi wanawiyari xetamekɨ mɨ'uarietɨkakɨ, mɨkɨ heima 'imatɨrieka manukawerire ketsɨ nawiyarieya 'aixɨa mɨ'ane keneuyuri.
Tuki hetsiemiemeta 'akatsiya mexayari keneutixixi, ma'utɨyani.
Xexuitɨ mexa nauka meturuyari heimana 'imeriyu pɨtɨni meta haika tewiyari heimana tamamata tsenitimeturuyari 'atayeyeutɨ,
meta mɨkɨ mexa xeitapa hutakɨa panumɨtsɨni, mexa heitserie mɨti'uwenikɨ yuhepaɨtsita. Naime mexa 'ematayeyeu tukitsie mieme mɨpaɨ pepɨtiwewieni.
Xeitewiyari mexa pɨyɨni, 'ameuyewatsie tatsutɨa mɨyekatsie.
»Huta tewiyari keneutiwewita pɨrata tepɨayarikɨ mexa hetsiena ma'uni, xexuitɨ mexa huhutatame pexeiyatɨkani, huhutatametsie meuka'unikɨ.
Tayeta muyekatsie 'ameuyewatsie miemeta keneutiwewi xeitewiyari mexa 'ematayeyeu tukitsie mieme.
Huta tewiyari pɨrata tepɨayari keneutiwewita mexa xexuitɨ mɨti'unitsie hetɨana pekaniti'uitɨamɨkɨ.
'Etsimeuyewatsieta 'ataxewime mexa keneu'uitɨa, tau makayuyuipike hepatsie,
tawarita xexuime keneuka'uitɨaxɨa mutatsikuritɨkatsie.
Mɨkɨ mexa yu'aurie puti'uka, yuxexuitɨ mituikatɨka pexeiyani, wapaitɨ xeihanirayarikɨ puyutseiriyani. Hutakɨa yaxeikɨa ketineuyuri mutatsikuritɨkatsie,
'atahaika mexayari pɨyɨni meta tamamata heimana 'ataxewi mexatɨa mieme pɨrata tepɨayari, huhutatame xeimexayaritɨamieme.
»'Akatsiya kɨyeyari pepɨtixixieni manukuhini: meta 'auxɨwime mexate tuki 'etsata mieme,
'auxɨwime tapa mieme, 'auxɨwimeta 'etsimauyewatsie mieme tuki manutinieretsie.
Kɨyexi ma'utɨka wahixɨapa mukuhuni mexate heutanetɨkaitɨ kaniyɨmɨkɨ.
Mexa mɨpepetsawi huru keneutiwiri meta huru hanirayari keneutiwewi manukuhini mana mauye'uixɨanikɨ. Yaxeikɨa manukuhini huru keneutiwiri.
Tuki keneutawewi kenematiuxeitsitɨa hɨritsie yemekɨ mɨpaɨ 'anekame.
»'Ixuriki 'ayeume keneutawewi meuwiere mɨyɨtsikimaɨyekɨ, kwimɨxetakɨ meta mɨxetakɨ meta rinu witsimɨ'anekɨ, Kakaɨyari teɨtametemama mehaxutɨkaime hetsiena.
Keneuwi huru kwatsituraiyarikɨ, nauka 'akatsiya 'ikitsaraɨyaritsie huru muwiriyarietɨkatsie tiwiyakame. Naukame pɨrata tepɨayaritsie pepe'uitɨani.
'Ixuriki hixɨapa keneutawi kwaitsituraitekɨ, Muyepatsietsie meta Waɨkawa Muyepatsietsie mukunatɨkanikɨ, tɨratu kakuniyari 'ixuriki warita mayekanikɨ.
Tɨratu kakuniyari kenanukanama kanamikiyarikɨ Kakaɨyari ma'axetsie, Waɨkawa Muyepatsietsie paitɨ,
'ixuriki meuwie hɨxietsie Waɨkawa Muyepatsietsie, tuki 'etsata tayeta muyekatsie mexa keneutiketsa. Kɨxeme 'uitɨwameta mexa hɨxie keneutiketsa tatsutɨa muyekatsie.
»'Ixuriki keneutawewi tuki kitenie mieme mɨyɨtsikimaɨyekɨ, kwimɨxetakɨ meta mɨxetakɨ rinu witsimɨ'anetsie tixukame.

Mɨkɨ 'ixuriki hetsiemieme, 'auxɨwime 'akatsiya kɨyeyari 'ikitsaraɨyari keneutixixi meta huru keneutiwiri, huru kwatsituraiyari hexeiyatɨkaime, meta wurunitsekɨ keneutiwewiri 'auxɨwime hetsiena ma'uni.
